reason: A DSH sidebar dashboard that reads local session usage data and presents token, estimated cost, model, context, achievement, and trend visualizations.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏中展示本机会话的 token 用量、估算成本、模型统计、上下文占用和趋势图表。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar dashboard for viewing local session token usage, estimated costs, model statistics, context utilization, and usage trends.

capabilities: Reads local DSH session projections and session history
Displays token usage, estimated costs, model statistics, and usage trends in a sidebar panel
Stores panel collapse state in browser localStorage
Registers a read-only host session projection
